entries.title: Psalms 116:1
segments: ¶I love the LORD, because he hath heard my voice [and] my supplications.

entries.title: Psalms 116:2
segments: Because he hath inclined his ear unto me, therefore will I call upon [him] as long as I live. {as long...: Heb. in my days}

words.text: unto me, therefore will I call
upon [him] as long as I live

entries.title: Psalms 116:3
segments: The sorrows of death compassed me, and the pains of hell gat hold upon me: I found trouble and sorrow. {gat...: Heb. found me}

entries.title: Psalms 116:4
segments: Then called I upon the name of the LORD; O LORD, I beseech thee, deliver my soul.

entries.title: Psalms 116:5
segments: Gracious [is] the LORD, and righteous; yea, our God [is] merciful.

entries.title: Psalms 116:6
segments: The LORD preserveth the simple: I was brought low, and he helped me.

entries.title: Psalms 116:7
segments: Return unto thy rest, O my soul; for the LORD hath dealt bountifully with thee.

entries.title: Psalms 116:8
segments: For thou hast delivered my soul from death, mine eyes from tears, [and] my feet from falling.

entries.title: Psalms 116:9
segments: I will walk before the LORD in the land of the living.

entries.title: Psalms 116:10
segments: ¶I believed, therefore have I spoken: I was greatly afflicted:

entries.title: Psalms 116:11
segments: I said in my haste, All men [are] liars.

entries.title: Psalms 116:12
segments: What shall I render unto the LORD [for] all his benefits toward me?

entries.title: Psalms 116:13
segments: I will take the cup of salvation, and call upon the name of the LORD.

entries.title: Psalms 116:14
segments: I will pay my vows unto the LORD now in the presence of all his people.

words.text: now in the presence of all his people

entries.title: Psalms 116:15
segments: Precious in the sight of the LORD [is] the death of his saints.

entries.title: Psalms 116:16
segments: O LORD, truly I [am] thy servant; I [am] thy servant, [and] the son of thine handmaid: thou hast loosed my bonds.

entries.title: Psalms 116:17
segments: I will offer to thee the sacrifice of thanksgiving, and will call upon the name of the LORD.

entries.title: Psalms 116:18
segments: I will pay my vows unto the LORD now in the presence of all his people,

words.text: now in the presence of all his people

entries.title: Psalms 116:19
segments: In the courts of the LORD'S house, in the midst of thee, O Jerusalem. Praise ye the LORD.
